memory_update.text: CHEF should remain a priority underfollowed candidate for the foodservice distribution dependency node because it directly serves independent/menu-driven restaurant procurement needs through specialty distribution.

HFFG is a speculative micro-cap exception with unusually direct node relevance in Asian restaurant procurement; keep only if later evidence confirms operating leverage, balance-sheet survivability and durable free cash flow.

Toast/xtraCHEF may represent the software-data layer of restaurant procurement dependency, but the thesis requires evidence of attach rate, monetization and management disclosure before it graduates beyond hypothesis.

Need a later pass on refrigerated logistics, specialty cold-chain operators, private procurement networks, and distributors embedded in hotel/travel foodservice channels; current pass is concentrated on public distributors and restaurant software.

node: Foodservice distribution, procurement concentration and independent-restaurant supply
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around independent-restaurant procurement dependency. The reference lane should use scaled foodservice distributors to understand bargaining power and route density, but the underfollowed lane is more interesting in specialty distribution, ethnic-food distribution, and invoice/procurement data software. The strongest underfollowed candidates from this pass are CHEF and HFFG because they sit directly in fragmented restaurant supply access. TOST is included as an adjacent procurement-data software hypothesis rather than a pure distributor. PFGC is retained as a reference anchor, not the main alpha target.
